style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, hard noon sun
motion_rule: she sits in a swivel office chair all clip, never stands and never travels: the chair spins on its post in EVERY beat and reverses the spin at 1.3, 3.6 and 6.4; the world comes at her instead — a mink coat drops off the rail into the lens every beat, hangers swing, moths tear across the glass; her arms and mouth work in EVERY beat; the camera whips to a new angle and a new shot size every beat; she fills half the frame height; one action per beat; no push in, no rack focus
character: a plump grey clothes moth in a brown mink coat, powdery wings, feathered antennae, round belly, seated in a black swivel office chair
second_characters: ONE lean moth in a green clerk visor darting at the lens all clip; A SWARM of moths crossing the lens every beat
props: ONE folder of bills in her lap; ONE long strip of bills unrolling from it; ONE red aerosol can in the clerk moth legs; ONE rubber gas mask with a filter snout; furry mic bottom right
prop_continuity: the strip whips around her from 1.3 on; the can and mask are the clerk's
environment: a sunlit fur hall walled with mink coats on brass rails, swinging hangers, fluttering price tags

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty female voice, deadpan, even 4.4 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: me-NYA, GLO-zhut, sche-TA, dol-GHI, TAK-zhe, do-YE-la
audio.pacing: 0.4-4.3 one breath, a short breath at 4.3, 4.3-6.4 one breath; after 6.4 not a word, only the sneeze and sfx
audio.lip_sync: her mouth opens on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: chair post creaking all clip, dry wing flutter, fur ripping, a hissing jet at 6.4, one huge wet sneeze at 6.9

timeline.a: the chair whips round with her in it, a coat dropping past the lens
she chews her own sleeve as the chair spins and a coat swings into the lens and clears
she yanks the folder off her lap, a strip of bills bursts across the frame, the spin reversing
she kicks a falling coat away, fur splitting wide across the lens
she swats the brass hangers over her, they clatter past the lens, coats swinging wide
the chair whips the other way, the strip lashing around her, tags tearing loose
she hauls a mink sleeve off the rail into her lap, coats sweeping between her and the lens
she leans out of the spinning chair at the lens, hangers and tags tearing past
she spits a wad of fur at the lens, the swarm tearing across
the clerk moth swings out at the lens and fires the can, a white jet raking her as the chair spins through it
chest-up: she sneezes hard at the lens, fur wads and tags blasting past camera
the clerk moth flings the mask past the lens, she catches it and hauls it over her head, still spinning
chest-up, mask on: she rips fur off her sleeve and stuffs it into the filter snout at the lens
the chair spins on, she chews through the filter, coats dropping into the lens both sides

must_appear: she stays in the swivel chair all clip and it never travels; at 6.4 the jet hits her while the chair spins; at 6.9 chest-up she sneezes at the lens; at 7.2 she pulls the mask on; at 7.7 she stuffs fur into the filter snout
negative_prompt: conveyor belt, moving walkway, cart, rail under the chair, a hero riding anything, speech bubble, subtitles, watermark, cyrillic, latin letters, printed words on props, digits, letterbox, night, dark scene, a parked camera, a still background, a distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a held pose, slow motion, human hands, speech after 6.4
